title: Provenance Anchor: Semantic Economy Framework Canonical Source Documentation for Authorized Extensions
creator: Framework author Lee Sharks
description:
A January 2026 provenance anchor by Lee Sharks declaring the archive’s canonical source and derivation rules for the Semantic Economy framework.

The document registers core theoretical terms, identifies Rex Fraction as an authorized enterprise-implementation usufructuary, distinguishes operational translations from canonical concepts, and defines minting, scope, attribution, revocation, and verification rules. Its “ownership,” “usufruct,” and minting language describes an archive-internal provenance and governance system layered over openly licensed works; it should not be represented as an external legal judgment restricting rights otherwise granted by the stated CC BY license.
